guide.summary: The bridge, Alcatraz, museums and Golden Gate Park gardens, with breakfast spots, dinners, cocktail bars, bakeries and coffee checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Book Alcatraz well ahead, since the National Park Service says it frequently sells out in advance, and avoid planning SFMOMA or the Conservatory of Flowers for a Wednesday, when both are closed.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: SFMOMA and the Conservatory of Flowers both close on Wednesdays, and Zuni Café is closed on Mondays. b. patisserie is closed Mondays and Tuesdays, and the Walt Disney Family Museum opens Thursday to Sunday only.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: The National Park Service says Alcatraz can sell out a month or more ahead in summer and near holidays, and the Japanese Tea Garden requires every visitor to reserve a time slot. Zuni Café and Foreign Cinema take reservations up to 60 days ahead, with Foreign Cinema releasing dates daily at 12:00 pm.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins
toolkit.copy: Hog Island Oyster Co. at the Ferry Building takes no reservations, and Outerlands seats Friday breakfast/lunch and weekend brunch on a walk-in basis only, for parties of up to 8. Trick Dog says reservations are not required, and Comstock Saloon welcomes walk-ins.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: From 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. you must prepay your cable car fare before boarding at Powell & Market, Bay & Taylor or Hyde & Beach, and bicycles are not allowed on board. Thursday NightLife at the California Academy of Sciences is for ages 21+, and pedestrians on the Golden Gate Bridge may use the east sidewalk only.

guide.dek: Book Alcatraz and timed garden entry first, then build your days around Wednesday museum closures and walk-in breakfasts.
intro: San Francisco rewards a little planning. The National Park Service says Alcatraz is open every day except Christmas, Thanksgiving and New Year's Day, with ferries leaving Piers 31-33 about every half hour from 8:45am, and that the island frequently sells out in advance, so book through the contracted ferry operator first. On the Golden Gate Bridge, you walk the east sidewalk only; from early November, under Pacific Standard Time, pedestrian gates are open 5:00 am to 6:30 pm. The bridge Welcome Center is open daily from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

For art, SFMOMA at 151 Third St is closed on Wednesdays and stays open until 8 p.m. on Thursdays; visitors 18 and younger get in free. Klee Behind the Mask runs until April 18, 2027, Feel the Beat: Dance in Photographs until February 28, 2027, and Sarah Sze: Forever is Composed of Nows opens November 21, 2026. In Golden Gate Park, the California Academy of Sciences recommends buying tickets in advance for weekends and holidays, and its Thursday NightLife evenings are for ages 21 and over.

The park's gardens run on their own rules. The Japanese Tea Garden requires a timed reservation, offers a free hour on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings from 9am to 10am, and moves last entry to 4:30pm from November to February. The Conservatory of Flowers is closed on Wednesdays and free on the first Tuesday of the month, while the San Francisco Botanical Garden is free every day from 7:30 to 9am. The Botanical Garden lists Lightscape from November 20 through January 3 for the 2026 winter season.

For food, you can walk in for breakfast at Plow from 7AM on weekdays, at Tartine Manufactory from 8am daily, or at Outerlands, where weekend brunch is walk-in only. The Ferry Building is open daily 6:00am to 10:00pm, with a farmers market on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, and Hog Island Oyster Co. there takes no reservations. For dinner, Zuni Café is closed on Mondays, and Tadich Grill now takes reservations. Smuggler's Cove is open seven days a week from 5:00PM, and Trick Dog says reservations are not required.
summaryCards: Pair a pre-booked Alcatraz ferry from Piers 31-33 with a walk on the Golden Gate Bridge's east sidewalk and a prepaid cable car ride from Powell & Market.

Start with a walk-in breakfast at Tartine Manufactory or Plow, then catch the San Francisco Botanical Garden's free 7:30 to 9am entry or the Japanese Tea Garden's free 9am hour on Monday, Wednesday or Friday.
Check that you aren't planning SFMOMA or the Conservatory of Flowers for a Wednesday, and reserve Zuni Café or Foreign Cinema up to 60 days ahead.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability, and several operators note that hours can change for holidays and events. Some confirmed places showed no 2026-dated content and are rated medium (Plow, Tadich Grill, House of Prime Rib, Buena Vista Cafe, b. patisserie, the Ritual Coffee branches, Philz Coffee); the NPS Alcatraz pages were last updated in 2021. Hours were not published on the pages read for Outerlands, Golden Gate Park or the cable cars, and Philz showed same-day hours only. The Golden Gate Bridge site gives no street address. These sites could not be read: de Young and Exploratorium (403), Blue Bottle (403), Andytown, Equator and Four Barrel (429), Tosca Cafe (certificate error), Musée Mécanique (connection refused), La Taqueria and Zazie (domain not found), Asian Art Museum visit page (404) and City Lights (redirect). Sightglass and Swan Oyster Depot domains redirected to unrelated sites. None of these failures is evidence of closure.
